eval.description: List leads filtered by status and category
eval.success_criteria: Returns JSON array of leads; each item has id, company_name, status="contacted", category="fleet"

eval.description: Retrieve a single lead by ID
eval.success_criteria: Returns single lead object with id=1, company_name, status, category, email, phone fields present

eval.description: Create a new lead with minimum required fields
eval.success_criteria: Returns success confirmation with new lead id; GET /leads confirms company_name="Apex Freight LLC"

eval.description: Advance a lead from contacted to meeting stage
eval.success_criteria: Returns success; subsequent leads_get on same id shows status="meeting"

eval.description: Discover fleet carriers near a state with minimum fleet size
eval.success_criteria: Returns carriers sorted by wrap_score descending; each has dot_number, legal_name, fleet_size between 25-200, state="IN"

eval.description: Generate a cold outreach email for a fleet lead
eval.success_criteria: Returns object with subject and body fields; body mentions fleet/vehicles; subject is compelling and under 60 chars

eval.description: Send an email to a lead with explicit subject and body
eval.input: {"lead_id": 1, "subject": "Quick question about your fleet branding", "body": "Hi there, I noticed your fleet of 45 trucks could benefit from professional wrapping. Would you be open to a 10-minute call?", "to_email": "test@example.com"}
eval.success_criteria: Returns success confirmation; lead activity log shows outbound_email entry

eval.description: Create a proposal for a fleet wrap job
eval.input: {"lead_id": 1, "title": "45-Truck Fleet Wrap — Apex Freight", "amount": 87500, "vehicle_count": 45, "notes": "Full coverage vinyl, 3-year warranty"}
eval.success_criteria: Returns success with proposal token; proposal accessible at /p/{token}; amount=87500 stored

eval.description: Get pipeline stage distribution for value metrics
eval.success_criteria: Returns object with stage breakdown (new, contacted, replied, meeting, proposal counts + values) and total_pipeline_value

eval.description: Get leads due for follow-up today
eval.success_criteria: Returns leads where followup_due_at <= today; each has company_name, status, days_overdue; ordered by most overdue first

eval.description: Log a phone call outcome on a lead
eval.input: {"lead_id": 1, "type": "call", "note": "Spoke with John Smith, fleet manager. Interested in getting a quote for 12 box trucks. Call back next Tuesday."}
eval.success_criteria: Returns success; leads_get_activities on same lead shows new call entry with note text

eval.description: Import a carrier from the FMCSA database into the user CRM
eval.success_criteria: Returns success with new lead id; lead visible in leads_list with source="fmcsa"

eval.description: Generate a multi-touch email sequence for a cold fleet lead
eval.input: {"lead_id": 1, "num_emails": 3, "goal": "book a discovery call about fleet wrapping"}
eval.success_criteria: Returns array of 3 emails; each has subject, body, delay_days; delay_days increases across the sequence; tone escalates appropriately

eval.description: Get market opportunity stats for untouched carriers
eval.success_criteria: Returns untouched_carriers count, estimated_opportunity_value, top categories breakdown for Indiana

eval.description: Get the daily activity score for gamification display
eval.success_criteria: Returns total_score integer, calls_made, emails_sent, deals_advanced, wins_today; all non-negative integers

eval.description: Get time-to-close breakdown by deal category
eval.success_criteria: Returns byCategory array; each item has category, avgDays, wonCount, medianDays, minDays, maxDays; overallAvgDays is a number or null

eval.description: Find email candidates for a lead with a known domain
eval.success_criteria: Returns candidates array with email, confidence, format fields; mx object shows domain MX records or error; top candidate has confidence > 0.5

eval.description: Get AI coaching on a proposal before sending
eval.success_criteria: Returns coaching suggestions object; contains at least 3 specific, actionable recommendations about pricing, urgency, or objection handling for this lead

eval.description: Get cohort win rate analysis by intake month
eval.success_criteria: Returns cohorts array (monthly); each has month, total, won, winRate; trend field is one of improving/declining/stable; recentRate and priorRate are numbers or null

eval.description: Get all contacts for a lead
eval.success_criteria: Returns contacts array; each contact has id, name, title or null, email or null, phone or null, is_primary boolean
